verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Failure, retry, dead-letter, and recovery semantics are especially complete: the board covers retry-triggering conditions, exponential backoff with jitter, attempt exhaustion, permanent-failure routing, intact DLQ contents, operator inspection, replay, and identity preservation.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The customer endpoint call has no idempotency key, omitting a system-defining duplicate-delivery safety mechanism explicitly required by the brief.
verdict.coverage_summary: Nearly the full ingress, fan-out, signing, delivery, retry, dead-letter, pause/resume, and observability contract is represented. Subscription expansion lacks the explicit one-delivery-per-endpoint cardinality, and the idempotency key is entirely absent. Weighted coverage is 53/56, but the absent system-defining idempotency requirement applies the RC cap of 6.
